claude_proposed_widenings.name: shared_item_resource_for_granted_spells
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item surface can model a shared charge pool only on ActivatedAbilityMechanics, which forces one item-level activation cost. Cube of Force instead has one shared 10-charge pool and recharge cadence, but grants six different spells that keep their own spell-specific casting times, including Shield as a reaction. A new composition shape is needed so granted spells can share one item resource without collapsing to one timing.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save DC 17), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table."

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_cube_of_force.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
